about: The quantities a metric may state, with the units each admits and the value forms (comparators) it admits. Extensible: add a quantity here. Nothing in the table is particular to a process. `dims` is 3 for a quantity stated as a triple (length x width x height).

envelope.text: the part's outer size, length x width x height

position.text: the position error of the object to its datums

straightness.text: the straightness of an edge or an axis

cylindricity.text: the cylindricity of a hole or a boss

roundness.text: the roundness of a hole or a boss

finish.text: the face's finish as seen: no marks of making on it

utilisation.text: the share of the strength the part uses under the stated load

deflection.text: the deflection under the stated load

production_time.text: the time to make one part

material_used.text: the material consumed to make one part

material.text: the material the part is made of

service_temperature.text: the temperature the part serves at
